Part 1 of the study enrolled 21 patients with Type 1 SMA at the time of enrollment.

result.text: 33% (7/21) of all patients and 41% (7/17) in the high-dose cohort achieved sitting without support for 5 seconds after 12 months; 85% were alive without permanent ventilation (event-free survival) at Month 12

citations.quote: Clinical efficacy data for patients in Part 1 of the study indicate that 33% (7/21) of all patients, and 41% (7/17) of patients treated in the high-dose cohort (Cohort 2), achieved sitting without support for 5 seconds or more, as assessed by Item 22 of the BSID-III gross motor scale
and 85% were alive while not requiring permanent ventilation (event-free survival) after 12 months of treatment with risdiplam.
